card.title: HONOR AND LOYALTY
card.text: Shuffle target friendly unit into your deck, then draw 2 cards.
card.flavorText: The French Foreign Legion, whose motto is “Honneur et Fidélité” (French for “Honor and loyalty”),  was involved in several campaigns during WWII, including the Norway Campaign, the North African Campaign and the Syria-Lebanon Campaign. The 13th Demi-Brigade of the Foreign Legion engaged in the Norwegian campaign in May 1940, where they suffered heavy losses at the Battle of Narvik. On June 4th they landed in Brittany, but they were forced to withdraw during the debacle and managed to board a ship bound for Scotland on June 21st, the day prior to the French Armistice. Afterwards the 13th Demi-Brigade was deployed in North Africa and in 1942 it participated in the Battle of Bir Hakeim as part of the British 8th Army. While Germany incorporated German legionnaires into the Wehrmacht's 90th Light Infantry Division in North Africa, many legionnaires answered General Charles de Gaulle's call to join the Free French Forces. However, some legionnaires were also loyal to the Vichy government and in the Battle of Damascus, during the Syria–Lebanon Campaign, one engagement at Kadem on June 20th saw legionnaires fighting legionnaires , resulting in one killed and one wounded. Nonetheless, later in the war thousands of Vichy legionnaires joined the Free French forces and would see combat in numerous operations and campaigns, both in North Africa and Europe.
